newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Kinhill welcomes A$46m offer from Halliburton unit.
newsitem.headline: Kinhill welcomes A$46m offer from Halliburton unit.

text.p: Engineering group Kinhill Holdings Ltd, an unlisted public company, said on Wednesday it welcomes a cash offer from a unit of U.S. energy and engineering group Halliburton Co ) which values it at A$46 million.

Kinhill chairman Malcolm Kinnaird said he believed a relationship with engineering services company Brown and Root Inc would enable Kinhill to boost annual revenue to A$500 million in the next few years from A$180 million now and help it become a formidable force in the Asia Pacific region.

The directors and staff of Kinhill and their related interests hold a major stake in the company, with retired employees and National Mutual being principal external shareholders, Kinnaird said in a statement.

Kinnaird, who is also chairman of cement manufacturer Adelaide Brighton Ltd, said he would remain chairman of Kinhill, while the company's managing director David Klingberg would take on the role of chief executive.
Brown and Root said in a statement the cash offer was conditional on acquiring sufficient shares so it could compulsorily acquire all shares.
The offer is for the purchase of about 21 million ordinary shares at A$1.64 per share on a fully paid basis, together with the acquisition of outstanding convertible notes and options.
